title: Introduction to Riemannian Manifolds (Second Edition)
institution: Springer (Graduate Texts in Mathematics 176); author page at the University of Washington
description: Graduate textbook on Riemannian geometry (second edition, 2018; originally 'Riemannian Manifolds: An Introduction to Curvature', 1997): what curvature is; Riemannian metrics (including pseudo-Riemannian metrics); model Riemannian manifolds; connections; the Levi-Civita connection; geodesics and distance; curvature; Riemannian submanifolds; the Gauss–Bonnet theorem; Jacobi fields; comparison theory; curvature and topology; appendices reviewing smooth manifolds, tensors and Lie groups. Named by the owner as the candidate textbook for MAT-262.
rightsNotes: Commercial book. The author's page provides only the front matter (title page, preface, table of contents) and an errata PDF; it states that the book can be read online only by those affiliated with a university that subscribes to Springer's GTM series. Reference-only: no text is imported, embedded or sent to a model.

Chapter locators below are book_reference locators built from the table of contents in the author-hosted front matter; chapter contents were not inspected. They let lessons point the learner to the right chapter if the book is acquired.
Acquisition request: a legitimate copy (print or eBook) is needed before any unit can assign reading from this book; until then MAT-262 reads from open sources and lists this book as recommended.
